Definition: genitive case singular of the same as G3062; remaining time:--from henceforth.
BiblicalUsage: loipoû means from henceforth, and the verse where it stands does the talking. In Galatians 6:17, "From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus."; and in Ephesians 6:10, "Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe from henceforth is the line Paul draws — let no man trouble me, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus, and henceforth I am strong in Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
